jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (3 days on-site)
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations implementation fit: owns state expansions, payer launches and cross-functional initiatives across Clinical Ops, Support, Payor Development and Product, using project plans, trackers, systems and metrics to improve patient experience.
jobs.gap: The role expects strong 0-to-1 project ownership and comfort with tools such as Asana/Jira plus frequent in-person NYC work; emphasize hands-on workflow launches and systems implementation without overstating technical depth.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Very strong match for healthcare implementation, workflow redesign, hospital partnership launches, project plans, stakeholder coordination, clinical/IT/operations alignment and process improvement. The stated 2–5 years of consulting, healthcare operations or project-based experience is unusually attainable.
jobs.gap: Travel is substantial at roughly 50%, and specialty-pharmacy experience would be helpful. Frame current healthcare operations and training work as transferable implementation leadership.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Operations
jobs.why: Strong behavioral-health and systems-operations fit spanning Product, Engineering, Design and Data, with project planning, requirements translation, launch readiness, process improvement, operating rhythms and data-informed reporting. The posting describes this as suited to someone in the earlier chapters of program management.
jobs.gap: The role sits inside Product & Tech rather than service operations and expects comfort with technical concepts such as integrations and APIs. Position Power Apps/automation/business-analysis experience clearly while keeping SQL at foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Health Information Retrieval Operations Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote (Eastern Time; semi-annual travel)
jobs.why: Newly posted healthcare operations role focused on KPI dashboards, AI-native monitoring, provider workflows, EHR access, process standardization, discrepancy resolution and cross-functional improvement. The top of the range clears the $100K target.
jobs.gap: Medical-record retrieval, risk adjustment audits and RADV/IPM experience are specialized areas not central to the current background; emphasize provider operations, intake documentation, compliance workflows and reporting while confirming compensation early.

jobs.title: Manager, Implementation & Operations
jobs.why: Excellent domain alignment with behavioral health plus partner implementations, project plans, technology setup, launch support, playbooks, workflow optimization and broader operations projects. Closely resembles current ABA healthcare operations and training work.
jobs.gap: The salary floor is below target, so only pursue if compensation can land above $100K. Oncology/collaborative-care experience is not direct, but the operational and behavioral-health overlap is strong.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: Remote · Eastern/Central time zones · travel to Boston
jobs.why: Strong implementation role serving healthcare-workforce employers, owning onboarding from signed partnership through launch, coordinating Product/Engineering and translating business requirements into technical solutions. Good match for project management, client communication and systems operations.
jobs.gap: The company prefers candidates in the broader New England area with frequent Boston access. Healthcare-workforce/benefits-platform experience is adjacent rather than direct.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - West Coast Preferred
jobs.why: Health-tech implementation role combining hardware/software deployments, project plans, customer training, workflow/process optimization, stakeholder management and KPI ownership in senior living healthcare.
jobs.gap: West Coast is preferred and travel can be very heavy, making logistics the main risk. Senior-level implementation expectations may also be a stretch relative to direct implementation-title tenure.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-AI implementation role focused on coordinating product installations, project documentation, timelines, client training, status reporting, risk tracking and hospital workflow adoption. Good bridge from healthcare operations/training into formal implementation work.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 3+ years of medical software/system implementation and familiarity with DICOM/networking standards. Those are meaningful technical gaps; do not imply experience you do not have.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS implementation role with end-to-end deployments, project plans, customer onboarding, data/workflow setup, go-live readiness, documentation and process standardization. Strong systems/project-management overlap and healthcare environment.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch requiring 5–8+ years plus Workday/Oracle Cloud ERP migration experience and familiarity with major consulting partners. Apply only with a resume emphasizing cumulative BA, implementation and operations experience accurately.

jobs.title: Core Operations Manager
jobs.why: Direct NYC healthcare-payer systems role spanning Provider Contracting, Credentialing, Claims Operations, Utilization Management, vendor performance, Jira/ServiceNow and operational process improvement. Strong healthcare-operations target with excellent compensation.
jobs.gap: Requires 5–7 years specifically in healthcare payer systems including claims processing, benefit configuration, provider data and system testing/migration. That payer-systems depth is the primary gap despite strong adjacent intake/operations experience.
